newsitem.title: USA: Lexmark sees Q2 revs below analysts' views.
newsitem.headline: Lexmark sees Q2 revs below analysts' views.

text.p: Lexmark International Group Inc said Monday it expects second quarter revenues to fall short of analysts' estimates.
Second quarter results may be affected by weak currencies and lower printer unit prices, the company said.
The company did not detail analysts' predictions on second quarter revenues. A year ago Lexmark posted second quarter revenues of $555.3 million and earnings of $0.40 per share.
Analysts estimate Lexmark's 1997 second quarter earnings at $0.50 per share, according to First Call.
The company said it expects a significant increase in second quarter operating expenses as a result of increased investment in marketing and sales.

Lexmark expects revenues for the full year to also be affected by the aforementioned factors. However, net earnings and earnings per share for the year should be in the current range of analysts' estimates, it said.
According to First Call, analysts estimate Lexmark's 1997 full-year earnings at $2.03 per share.
The company reported 1996 full-year earnings of $1.68 per share.
